meta.description: Tesla Supercharger 'Busy Times & Price Per kWh' hourly profiles for Georgia sites, pulled from the public tesla.com/findus API (get-charger-details.availabilityProfile) with chart screenshots for audit.
notes: hours is Tesla's chart order (starts 4a). bar_shares = 7-day mean congestion normalized to sum 1.0; bar_shares_weekday / bar_shares_weekend / bar_shares_by_day likewise.

congestion_* values are Tesla's raw congestionValue (0..1 share of stalls occupied, averaged by hour). The chart's dashed line sits at 1.0 (full occupancy) and is drawn on TOU-priced sites; dashed_line_ratio = 1.0 / tallest mean bar.
Tesla's API arrays are indexed by UTC hour; they were shifted with the site utcOffset (-4h EDT) to local time, wrapping into the next UTC day after 8p local, exactly as tesla.com renders the chart.
price_bands are Tesla-member (TSLA) per-kWh rates; price_bands_non_tesla are non-Tesla (NACS) rates. Bands start at midnight (0a).

Screenshots are the chart canvas exported from tesla.com as rendered on the capture day (screenshot_day, current hour drawn black). screenshot_chart_matches_json records that the rendered dataset equalled the API profile for that day.
host_branded comes from brandName/ownershipType in the API. Tesla lists host-owned sites under findus location_type 'party' rather than 'supercharger'/'nacs'.
